title: Swing on a rope
description: A steel ball hangs in the air at (120, 240) and falls from the start. A short fixed beam, the hook, sits at (200, 280) near the top. A bell hangs at (290, 215) from a bracket 30 cm above it. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 20 to 260. The bell is too far right for the ball to fall onto.
